verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is open-source and self-hostable (Dockerized deployment), which implicitly lets a user choose the physical location/region where their crawl data resides, since there is no vendor-hosted SaaS storing data by default. However, there is no explicit documentation, feature, or setting for data residency/region selection — the evidence never discusses this as a deliberate product capability. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, documented data-storage location controls, and any statement addressing compliance/residency requirements.
